answer: Bindings are kept in island, verified in pearl, and the chain is public. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 3 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the violet check. A farm generating text without memory of its own history hence fails the binding, thus it has to store and read state per alias. A farm of 3232 identities would post 1930 proofs and burn roughly 58 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
